notes.title: Patch 0.6.0 – New Quality of Life Improvements
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Pioneers,[/h2]

It's here! Our next update is packed with Quality-of-Life-Improvements and brand new features that will enhance your game experience of Pioneers of Pagonia. Take your time and read the patch notes carefully, because this update is full of great new stuff!

[b]What's new?[/b]
[list]
[*]New Village State: Acquainted
[*]Building Construction Mode: New Help Grid & Snapping to Road
[*]Road Construction Mode: 90 Degree Snapping
[*]Efficiency Statistics
[*]Demolish Refund and Visualization
[*]New Additional Light Setups
[*]And many more!
[/list]
Find the full list of changes in the patch notes below.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Developer Notes[/h2]

The month of April just flew by and It feels like yesterday, that we've released our first multiplayer mode! It definitely made us really happy to watch all the co-op livestreams on Twitch. But, of course, there is still so much more to do! We kept ourselves busy by working on a bunch of new features and improvements we would like to share with you today.

[h3]New Village State: Acquainted[/h3]
Being kind to other factions will pay off much sooner than before! The new state "Acquainted" is already achieved with 50% faction standing and will unlock some trade and gift offers with your friendly Pagonians from the neighborhood. This makes sure you can profit from the benefit of trade much earlier in the game.

[h3]New Building Construction Mode and Road Construction Mode[/h3]
This one will please everyone, who prefers to plan out their settlements very accurately. First of all, there will be a [b]new help grid[/b], which will inform you about space available around the current building. This will make it much easier to estimate space for roads and other planned buildings!

Secondly, the entrance of a building will automatically [b]snap to the road[/b] while hovering over an existing road or very close to it. This will definitely save you some time and make building your beautiful village much easier.

And lastly, this is for everyone, who loves 90 degree angles and straight lines: don't worry, we got you! The [b]new road construction mode[/b] allows new planned roads to automatically snap to [b]90 or 180 degree angles[/b] if the current mouse position is close to those axes.

[h3]Efficiency Statistics[/h3]
Now you will get even more information on individual buildings! Just hover over a building and it will show the efficiency value in the building tooltip. Also, if you select a building, the efficiency value is shown, too! This is very helpful to understand whether the building is operating continuously or not, and at which efficiency level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/53378f8337c42116c19f8e7090032cb508719a5b.png[/img]

[h3]New Additional Lighting Setups[/h3]
We saved the best for last: Let us introduce three brand new lighting setups to make Pagonia look stunning! (it looked stunning before, but this is a whole new vibe!) 

By using a hotkey (default: CTRL+L) it’s possible to change the current map lighting setup at any time. We are soo happy with how they turned out, because each of them is looking gorgeous and sets an entirely different mood! 

We can't wait for you to try the different lighting setups and let your villages shine! Please share your screenshots with us on Discord or in the Steam Community Hub, we would love to see them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/97d39a35eaf743f42e63657bbd86da2078e50299.png[/img][i]Sunrise[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/65b104fab434d920bad9493efb17863de7a20df8.png[/img][i]Cloudy Daytime (Default)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/de8b8e9d484f0d763eb140063ea856541c313def.png[/img][i]Golden Hour[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/97bf1e428bd4b5594e48d6654f52079250b5e30a.png[/img][i]Sunset[/i]

And this is not all, there are more features in the patch notes below! We hope you enjoy these improvements in your next game session.

[b]Pick up the tools, Pioneers![/b]
Your [i]Envision Entertainment [/i] Team

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Patch Notes 0.6.0[/h1]

[h2]Features[/h2]

[h3]New Village State: Acquainted[/h3]
[list]
[*]The new state “Acquainted” is already achieved with 50% faction standing
[*]The “Acquainted” state already unlocks some trade and gift offers
[*]The overall amount of trade and gift offers has been increased
[/list]
[h3]Building Construction Mode: New Help Grid[/h3]
In building construction mode, a help grid will now also inform about space available around the current building position. This is very helpful to immediately recognize if there is enough room to build a road along or around the building. Beside that, it helps in general to estimate available space for other planned buildings nearby.

[h3]Building Construction Mode: Snapping to Road[/h3]
In building construction mode, hovering over an existing road or very close to it will snap the entrance direction of the planned building to the road. This means it is still possible to place buildings sideways to roads, but also to snap them to the road directly without the need to rotate the building.

[h3]Road Construction Mode: 90 Degree Snapping[/h3]
In road construction mode, new planned roads will snap automatically to 90 and 180 degree angles if the current mouse position is close to those axes. The new planned road segment will snap to existing road segments, previous planned road segments and to existing buildings/construction sites.
[list]
[*]Road snapping can be enabled and disabled with a new button in the road construction menu
[*]Road snapping can be suppressed by holding CTRL (customizable)
[/list]
[h3]Efficiency statistics: Individual building efficiency display[/h3]
[list]
[*]For each building with a continuous workflow, an efficiency value is shown
[list]
[*]Hovering over a building will show the efficiency value in the building tooltip
[*]For a selected building, the efficiency value is displayed, too. The tooltip of the value will show the efficiency graph for the last hour. This is very helpful to understand whether the building is operating continuously or not, and at which efficiency level.
[/list]
[*]Efficiency values are displayed for the following buildings:
[list]
[*]9 different gathering buildings (Woodcutter, Quarry, Copper hut, etc.)
[*]16 different production buildings (Sawmill, Weaponsmith, etc.)
[*]Both farm buildings, reflecting successful harvesting
[*]Forester, reflecting successful planting of trees
[*]Tavern, reflecting successful meal ingredient usage
[*]Guard Tower / Garrison, reflecting territory expansion
[*]Explorer, reflecting unknown territory exploration
[/list]
[*]The efficiency value reflects actual positive results, not if the units are continuously busy. The value of 100% is a best case value, it can be lower for many reasons, depending on the building type. Here are some examples:
[list]
[*]Longer walk distances (for gathering buildings, farms, territory building, explorer, etc.)
[*]Missing input commodities, missing food supply (for mining) or full output piles
[*]Weaker ingredients which consume more production time (copper instead of iron)
[*]Rotting plants (for farms: more seeding, less harvesting)
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]Economy enhancement: Commodity redirection by more flexible input piles[/h3]
[list]
[*]Equipment items in training buildings which are currently not needed for the ordered and scheduled units of that building, will be released and redirected to other locations if they are needed there. This ensures that equipment can be exchanged between e.g. multiple guild houses or multiple military academies to handle the training/recruitment orders.
[*]Input commodities in buildings which are currently not needed because their recipe has been disabled, will be released and redirected to other locations if they are needed there.
[/list]
[h3]Demolish refund and visualization[/h3]
[list]
[*]Demolishing a building grants 50% (rounded down) of wood/stone construction materials that were used to construct the building
[*]Cloth and rope are refunded 100%
[*]A tooltip shows the amount of commodities refunded
[*]A simple demolish visualization has been added
[*]The demolish refund can help to escape deadlock situations (no more softwood beams, no more stone deposits, no more nutrition food for quarries)
[/list]
[h3]New additional lighting setups[/h3]
[list]
[*]For customized maps you can select between one of several new lighting setups. At the very end of the “Map Setup” section, you will find a new dropdown for “Atmosphere”
[*]By pressing a hotkey (default: CTRL+L) it’s possible to change the current map lighting setup at any time. The last active lighting setup will be part of the savegame.
[*]The 4 available lighting setups are:
[list]
[*]Sunrise
[*]Cloudy Daytime (Default)
[*]Golden Hour
[*]Sunset
[/list]
[*]New directional atmospheric fog
[list]
[*]The fog color reacts when facing the sun
[*]Can be deactivated in the settings
[/list]
[/list]
[h2]Improvements[/h2]

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*]When a hunter is selected, nearby animals get highlighted
[*]Rations and nutrition meals now still look different after being served at mining buildings
[/list]
[h3]Map Setups[/h3]
[list]
[*]The landing party “Beginner” now contains some trade carriers
[*]Added enemy level “Extremely many” which adds another 50% of enemies
[*]Added landing party “Beginner (Extended for co-op)”
[*]This landing party has been created for co-op to allow a faster game start. It has both more units and more commodities. Adding more enemies keeps the overall challenge similar.
[/list]
[h3]Visuals[/h3]
[list]
[*]Improved reflection on the cliff textures
[/list]
[h3]Misc[/h3]
[list]
[*]Audio mixing
[*]Saved games can be deleted from the load and save menus
[*]Loading the game to the main menu with many saved games is now faster.
[*]Switched trade UI layout for better readability so that the player is on left side and the NPC side is on right side
[*]Improvements in the UI layout 
[*]Improvements of the localized texts
[*]Improved rendering performance through optimized LOD levels for characters
[*]Optimized VRAM usage with optimized texture compression setup
[*]“Join Co-op game” button got a tooltip
[*]Reworked visuals for the thieves
[*]Improved rendering of distance fog
[*]Performance improvements on maps with a lot of Pagonians
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed: Sometimes the building state “Construction paused” was not removed even though the building got finished
[*]Fixed: Sometimes a guard tower did not get any reinforcements
[*]Fixed: When a soldier was living in a residence or cottage, its selection window did not reflect this
[*]Fixed: A Pagonian bitten by a werewolf would still show “Ready for new orders” when selected
[*]Fixed: A bitten Pagonian did not have an icon
[*]Fixed: Building preview got stuck at its current location if cursor hovers any UI while holding right mouse button
[*]Fixed: Fishers do not block traffic
[*]Fixed: Storage pile not accepting commodities under some circumstances
[*]Fixed issue where farmers would disregard work orders
[*]Fixed issues where neutral village territories would prevent road accessibility for points of interest
[/list]
[h3]Visuals[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed: Sometimes fish were swimming into the ground when close to the shore
[*]Forester now carries different looking hardwood and softwood saplings
[*]Fixed: State "not enough to do for all staff members at the moment" stayed active when building was turned off
[*]The color of porcini and raspberries baskets was too similar, so the white blanket was removed from the porcini basket
[*]Fixed: Black rabbits suddenly turned red when dead.
[/list]
[h3]Misc[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed: When changing the language, not all text was updated to the new language
[*]Fixed several crashes
[*]Fixed: Placed pings in a co-op session persisted in the world after last client left the session
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Live Stream and Community Challenge
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Pioneers,[/h2]

what's better than celebrating the upcoming update with a dev livestream? If you want to watch the devs play Pioneers of Pagonia and get their rear ends bitten by werewolves, then join us on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2155180/Pioneers_of_Pagonia/]Steam[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCQZwU3nXE6nABIrSWQbHEVQ]YouTube[/url] and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/envision_entertainment]Twitch[/url] next week! When? May 14th at 4 pm CEST.

This time our community manager Katharina will play a co-op session together with our lovely QA-Team (Mirjam, Chris and Samuel). This is your chance to ask everything you always wanted to know about Quality Assurance and other behind-the-scenes topics, while we try to beat a very special map. (And showing you all the crisp new features of our next update, of course!)

We've also been working on a little treat for all of you, Pioneers! (Drumroll please ...) Let us introduce to you the very first and official Community Challenge called "Find the Lost Artifacts"!

[h2]Community Challenge: Find the Lost Artifacts[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/c14e09b98c70e6e6808b696da969751ade60f9d1.png[/img]

[u]How it works:[/u]

We have prepared a special map for you, where several artifacts are hidden in secret locations. The goal is to find all artifacts, beat whatever obstacle you encounter and let your carriers bring the artifacts back to your treasury.

Please note: There are no other NPC factions on the map and you won't find the challenge in your objectives! (we just kept it simple.) You can ignore the map goal of "defeat all enemies" for the challenge. The only win condition to enter the giveaway is to store all [b]three artifacts[/b] in your treasury!

But there is more! Everyone who beat the challenge can enter our giveaway. For a chance to win one of three Pagonia-Goodie-Packages, send us your savegame with the completed challenge to the following email address:

pagoniachallenge@envision-entertainment.de

The three winners are chosen randomly from the submitted entries! (given the savegames are valid and the challenge was won)

We will provide the savegame with the Challenge Map on our [url=https://discord.gg/pagonia]Discord-Server[/url] and as a Download on our [url=https://pioneersofpagonia.com/downloads/pioneers_of_pagonia_challenge_map.zip]homepage[/url] on May 14th. Then you'll have two weeks time to complete the challenge and submit your entry. 

[b]Submissions will close on May 28th, 6 pm CEST.[/b]

[i]Pick up your tools and good luck, Pioneers![/i]

P.S. We will play a variation of the challenge map on stream to not spoil the fun of finding the artefacts yourself. So you can watch the stream spoiler free!

notes.title: Farming Fest 2024 – Get 15 % off Pioneers of Pagonia!
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Pioneers,[/h2]

We are excited to announce that we are part of this year's [b]Steam Farming Fest[/b]!

[h2]Steam Farming Fest 2024[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/db0500e1d608ef6bb718bbb193e74a77aaf84bdf.png[/img]

The event is running from [b]April 29th to May 6th. [/b]This is your chance to get 15 % off Pioneers of Pagonia. The sale will start on April 29th at 10 a.m. PDT. We are delighted to be showcased next to so many cool farming games!

[h2]Farming in Pagonia[/h2]

The economy in Pagonia pretty much wouldn't work without our signature windmill and our farming system. Let us give you a quick summary of how it works:

The crop farm is designed for growing wheat, corn and flax. Once harvested, the goods are waiting to be picked up for further processing. Corn goes to the market stalls and wheat goes to the windmill for producing flour. Flax will be carried to the weaver where it is used to make cloth and rope. However, flax does not need to be grown, it can be foraged, too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/85a2e49591f1e9eb11c942793403f9cf04a46076.png[/img][i]Windmill and Crop Farm[/i]

Pagonian farmers will work on fields nearby the vegetable farm in order to produce cabbages and pumpkins. After sowing the seed and watering the plants with water from the well, the veggies will be harvested and delivered to market stalls. 
 
Good farmers know their land! In Pagonia it does make a difference where certain plants are grown. For example, the cultivation of wheat requires more fertile lands, which are much harder to find. Pumpkins, on the other hand, grow pretty much everywhere!

There you have it! Now you can become an excellent Pagonian farmer yourself. If you like farming in Pagonia, maybe you also like to check out other farmed-themed games during the Farming Fest.

Happy farming and see you in Pagonia!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2155180

notes.title: Dev Blog #8: Roadmap Update – Mining, Magic and More!
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Pioneers,[/h2]
today we would like to share what's coming next for Pioneers of Pagonia! After reading all of your feedback and discussing many possible features we came up with a plan. First of all, our first multiplayer mode, [b]Shared Co-op[/b], was released in April. We had so much fun in our test rounds that we decided to bring the release forward and publish the new co-op-feature earlier than originally planned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/3c7ecbc684fe49f0fe71b38a736c4ceaca6f5fe8.gif[/img]

We hope you enjoy building your village together with your friends! Other multiplayer modes are not excluded from our vast list of ideas. For now we focus on other features that we consider imperative for the game. See our list of planned features on our latest roadmap. 

[h2]What Comes Next in Pagonia?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/0288cb42a816b7a75ad4a2833fe5306325f247be.png[/img]

[h2]Quality of Life Update[/h2]

Currently we are working on the next [b]Quality of Life Update[/b] which will contain some minor improvements. We cannot share details yet, but we can say as much as this: You will see Pagonia in a truly different light! :) We will announce the Beta release for our play testers very soon, it will drop before the next major update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/54b9126c6397869b94ec215d89d9d48ccd45669f.gif[/img][i]Golden hour in Pagonia[/i]

[h2]Mining Update[/h2]

Speaking of ... the next content update is going to be a big one: The [b]Mining Update[/b] will provide a lot of new content. We will introduce subsurface mining, steel and gold production as well as a brand new enemy type: [i]The Scavengers![/i] This one will be very different from every other hostile units. And there is more – a lot of people have been asking for this – we will finally add the Geologist! We are very excited about this one, too, because we hired a very special voice actor for this unit. The German community will definitely recognize the voice. Write your wildest guesses in the comments!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/f95ef406f4551205acce5f07b11086bbe2937ede.png[/img]

[h2]Magic Update [/h2]

There is still more to come this year! The next milestone is the [b]Magic Update[/b], where new magical units and enemies will join Pagonia. But we will tell you more about those in time. If you look closely on the roadmap, you will also find [b]Future Early Access Updates[/b], such as modding support, map obstacles, further lore & backstory and more. We have already started to work on some of them, but cannot put a fixed date for the release yet. 

[h2]Challenge Map[/h2]

During the release of our Co-op-Update our Creative Director Volker Wertich played together with German streamers. Some of them were quite ambitious and wanted to challenge themselves with an extremely difficult map. So we created a map for everyone who likes the extra challenge! The number of enemies is increased to 150 %. If you want to try the map for yourself, take a look at our [url=https://discord.gg/pagonia]Discord [/url]where you will find the save games. Due to popular request we will add the extremely difficult map to the game in the next update.

[h2]Conventions[/h2]

It has been a month since we showcased our game at [b]PAX East[/b] in Boston and we had such a nice experience abroad! We had an absolute blast and met so many lovely people. It also made us realize how important the direct exchange with our players is and how much we enjoyed to get to know the American gaming community. Thank you for visiting our booth and checking out Pioneers of Pagonia. It was definitely not our last game expo and we are already thinking about the next one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/0a92ecca2d5f5784143de21588fa70bc63326a26.jpg[/img][i]PAX East booth crew[/i]

As always, we would like to thank our dedicated community, i.e. the people who follow us from the very beginning as well as the ones, who just recently found out about us. Thank you so much for engaging in our journey, finding bugs, testing new features and sharing all of your great ideas for the game. This makes this experience very special and keeps us motivated to make the best game possible for you. 

But, there is still so much to do! We take up our tools and will see you in the next update!

Your, [i]Envision Entertainment[/i] Team

notes.title: Co-op Update 0.5.0
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Pioneers,[/h2] 

We are excited to announce the release of our next major content update: [b]Shared Co-op[/b] is now available! Get ready to play Pioneers of Pagonia together with your friends! The last weeks working on this feature have been a lot of fun. If you are looking for groups to play together do not hesitate to join our [url=https://discord.gg/pagonia ]Discord[/url] channel and connect with other players.  

Catch a first glance at gameplay by watching this short clip of our devs playing a Co-op-Session. Even game devs are not safe from hungry werewolves. :D 

[previewyoutube=WaFVhMibozc;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]What’s new?[/b] 
[list] 
[*]Shared Co-op: Up to four Players!
[*]Three Ways to team up! 
[*]Multiplayer Saves 
[*]New Interface Features 
[*]Improved Audio Mixing 
[*]Several Fixes 
[/list] 
Find the full list of changes in the patch notes below. 
[hr][/hr] 
[h1]Patch Notes 0.5.0[/h1] 

[h2]New Feature: Co-op Mode[/h2] 
[b]Shared Co-op[/b] is our first multiplayer mode. It means that up to four players can play one faction together without limitations. Any team member may place buildings, paths, send commands or change settings at any time for that one faction. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/445771da8cc33f818949b38f995b83ce12c31712.png[/img] 

[h3] To team up, there are 3 ways: [/h3] 
[list] 
[*] You can join a Steam friend currently playing Pioneers of Pagonia anytime, if that player has set their game to “open for friends” and not to “private”. 
[*] While you are running a game, you can also invite Steam friends to join your game via the Steam friend invite overlay. 
[*] You can also copy a game ID of your current match and share it with other people to allow them to join. This is helpful if you want someone to join who is not on your Steam friend-list or if you want to make sure that only specific players who received the code can enter. To that end, players who have your current game ID can join even if your game is set to “private”, so no random friends can join in who just happen to see you play in Steam. 
[/list] 
[h3] Multiplayer saves: [/h3] 
[list] 
[*] Any player participating can save multiplayer games, any player participating can continue the saved games. Other players can join until the player limit, currently 4 players, is reached. While the player who sets up the map is defined as the host, anyone else can take over that role in a restart when loading a save game. They can also continue alone later if they want to, so savegames can be used both for single player and shared co-op gameplay. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/857926efcd44e800e0d0e38de6dc312a5a6ddd3c.png[/img]

[h3] Interface features: [/h3] 
[list] 
[*] You can see a list of all participating players and their connection quality.  
[*] Each player receives an individual player color, which is used to differentiate the players in the user interface. The color is visible on the player's name list for easy recognition. 
[*] You can see where other players currently plan to place a building with an outline of their player color. 
[*] You can see the camera position of other team members on the overview map in their player color. 
[*] You and your team members can “ping” locations in the world (even multiple ones at a time) to mark points of interest, and those are both shown on the overview map and the world view in the respective player color. 
[*] If one or more players select a building, this is also visualized in the game world view with an outline border of their player color. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/c16a4bc11a9251ca0367397e895e5c54f5518d46.png[/img]
 
[h3] Playing together: [/h3] 
[list] 
[*] The host can pause the game by entering the game menu (ESC key) 
[*] The host can change the game speed 
[*] If commands of team members conflict, they get automatically resolved. E.g. if one interaction turns another one invalid, e.g. because there is no longer enough room for a building, the first command stays valid.  
[*] The UI feedback (e.g. you see if another player currently selects a building, probably to change settings) helps to avoid simultaneous actions unless intended. But parallel actions are still allowed whenever possible, e.g. multiple players can adjust settings, in the same building simultaneously. 
[/list] 
[h2]Improvements[/h2]  
[list] 
[*] Audio mixing 
[*] Better logging for specific classes of errors
[*] Improved diagnostics for some crash types
[/list] 
[h2]Fixes[/h2]  
[list] 
[*] Fixed: When cycling through buildings with the TAB key, it no longer jumps to invalid positions 
[*] Fixed: Sometimes an error message was shown that a guildhall was missing even if there was one 
[*] Fixed: Some buildings were showing smoke during construction preview 
[*] Fixed: The enable guidance checkbox in the start new game flow was sometimes missing 
[*] Fixed: Fixed issues where POIs could not be reached with roads
[*] Fixed: Fixed several crashes during map generation
[*] Fixed: Fixed several minor issues to improve map generation
[*] Fixed: Tavern tables no longer count as building for the Build Buildings objective
[*] Fixed: Builders and diggers will now finish their current work step when the building is paused during construction before leaving the building
[*] Fixed: Upon changing the language not all texts were updated to the new language until the game was restarted
[*] Fixed: Changed display of meal quality statistics to better reflect actual data
[*] Fixed: Boars' selection window now explains that they scare civilians
[*] Fixed: Non-fighting units do no longer display their combat strength
[/list]

notes.title: Economy Update 0.4.0
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Pioneers,[/h2]

We are beyond excited to announce the release of our first major [b]Economy Update[/b]. The Fishing Hut was by far the most requested building after we launched into Early Access last year in December and we are so happy to finally share it with you! Do you prefer to go fishing at sunny beaches or calm lakes in Pagonia? We definitely enjoy both!

[b]What's new?[/b]
[list]
[*]Fisher and Fishing Hut 
[*]New Commodities: Trout and Herring
[*]Warehouse Storage Building with 8 Piles
[*]Production and Unit Statistics
[*]Increased Camera Zoom 
[*]Improved Shadow Quality
[*]And many more improvements!
[/list]
Find the full list of changes in the patch notes below.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Developer Notes[/h2]
It's time to pick up the tools, Pioneers! Or should we say, the fishing rods? Because from now on, not only does it feel like you are watching a fish tank, but you can actually watch schools of fish swimming in the ocean and lakes of Pagonia! Let us tell you everything you need to know:

[h3]The Fishing Hut[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/3e70c67d9a1c8881f4c472b77e0e95bffece1355.png[/img]

The Fishing Hut is a gathering building (like the Hunter’s Lodge) with three workers who work independently from each other. Fishers are recruited at the Guild Hall and need a fishing rod as their tool, which is made at the Wood Workshop. The Fishing Hut can be placed anywhere and has a maximum range and a focus point like other gathering buildings in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/4ee58f4d8fc1a744139ee9af7f5644e4490a7c29.png[/img]

[h3]How does Fishing work?[/h3]
Fish can spawn in any body of water in Pagonia. There are two types of fish:
[list]
[*][b]Ocean Fish[/b] (Herring) with a nutritious meal value of 6
[*][b]Lake Fish[/b] (Trout) with a comfort meal value of 6
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/3b8c944448f50b07aff72747974bc0928bae7716.gif[/img]

Unlike to other wild animals in Pagonia, you do not see the actual number of fish in the game world, but you will need to look for schools of fish in the water, which are an indicator of fish occurrence. You will be able to adjust the number of fish in the ocean and in lakes in the map generation settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/79966d43bb1ef753a35ebee5b93406ea04f3fe59.gif[/img]

Pagonian fishers are quite skilled in their profession and will prefer fishing spots with more fish in range. However, they do not catch a fish with every try. If they fail to catch a fish after three tries in a row, they will return to their hut empty handed. Hope for better luck next time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/795cf33e416a992282a81e6359fcb465d374c523.gif[/img]

Fish serves as an additional source of food that is quite easy to obtain. Like other food commodities, fish will be prepared for comfort and nutritious meals at the Tavern. However, fish can also be used for rations prepared at the Provisioner.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/6264b42bf4761bc25de185584fdba606fd6b64d2.png[/img]

[h3]Warehouse Storage Building[/h3]

It's bigger, it's better, it is the big Warehouse building! Now you can store up to 8 different commodities and up to 64 units per piles in total. If you like to keep your resources in order, you can choose and set the contents of each pile manually or use a template for quick setups. Each pile can be manually set to priority.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/8a63385190f397795308b4f099e516dacae7e1e4.png[/img]

[h3]Production and Unit Statistics[/h3]

We also decided to add statistics to provide over-time feedback on request for many different economy values. You can access the small graphs with a quick mouse-over while playing. They always reflect the last hour to grant context and include information on commodities that were traded or lost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/47040310b64b20f0e199acf55f148f050ce5cc2d.png[/img]

You will also have a much better overview of your population growth. With the new unit statistics tooltips you can observe the development of total values like balance of homes, total amount of units (combat, construction, carrier etc.) and many more! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/1163704cdda2cdbe660eb0b3e863aa4c56213762.png[/img]

[h3]Camera Zoom[/h3]
This was also highly requested by the community. It is now possible to zoom out the camera further to get a better overview of your beautiful Pagonian villages. Enjoy the "Wuselfaktor" from above! :)

We hope you get some early summer vibes while going fishing at the beach or at dreamy lakes. We definitely cannot wait to read what you think! Please share your feedback with us in Discord or in the Steam forum. 

Happy fishing everyone!
Your [i]Envision Entertainment [/i] Team

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Patch Notes 0.4.0[/h1]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[h3]Fisher[/h3]
[list]
[*]Herrings have been added to the ocean and Trout swim in the lakes
[*]Your fishers head out to promising shores in range and try to catch them
[*][b]Note that save games from the versions before 0.4.0 do not contain fish deposits, therefore the fisher has nothing to find[/b]
[*]Fish can be used to create rations or supply market stalls
[*]Herrings are used in nutrition meals, Trout in comfort meals
[*]The comfort meal score needed to gain population beyond 750 Pagonians has been increased to reflect availability of fish
[*]The amount of nutrition necessary for mining is unchanged for now as subsurface mining will impact this with a later game update
[/list]

[h3]Warehouse Storage Building with 8 Piles[/h3]
[list]
[*]Offers space for up to 8 different commodities, and up to 64 units of each one
[*]The contents of each pile can be chosen and set manually:
[*]Any specific commodity (e.g. silver blade)
[*]Any commodity of a group (e.g. any weapon, will be occupied as soon as production piles of any weapon type fill up)
[*]Any commodity (will be occupied as soon as any production piles fill up)
[*]Nothing (pile will be emptied / stay empty until changed)
[*]Some templates offer quick setups, e.g. “construction depot” for all 8 commodities used for construction
[*]Each pile can be manually set to priority. This means the Warehouse is supplied with priority for that commodity and will only redirect and offer these priority commodities to other buildings which are set to priority.
[*]The functionality of the standard storage building has been adjusted to the same behavior.
[/list]

[h3]Production Statistics[/h3]
[list]
[*]Production and consumption statistics added to the tooltip of each commodity
[*]Reflect the production and consumption history of the last hour of each commodity
[*]Includes information for commodities traded or lost (e.g. stolen)
[/list]

[h3]Unit Statistics[/h3]
[list]
[*]Various statistics have been added to the tooltips of the unit interface
[*]Reflect the changes during the last hour, delivering valuable information, e.g.
[*]Amount of specific unit types like carriers, diggers or builders and how many of them are idle
[*]Development of total values like Balance of homes, total amount of combat units, wealth and many more
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*]Reworked “Start new game” flow to better distinguish between guidance maps, preselected maps, generated maps and playing with / without enemies. 
[*]Removed the original guidance map without NPC villages
[*]Added two new maps to the predefined maps section
[*]New storage building behavior
[*]Configure piles individually or choose from several storage presets (e.g. mining resources, construction material, …) for all piles at once.
[*]Priority storing and delivery can be set per pile. 
[*]Reworked distribution of surplus commodities to storages and warehouses: The supply will now depend on fill state much more than on distance
[*]This ensures that multiple distant locations get supplied simultaneously instead of the more distant ones only getting supplied after closer ones are full. 
[*]It is useful to distribute commodities in advance and shorten delivery distance e.g. for border stones, construction materials, and more.
[*]Manual production orders and building priority setting is removed from NPC Village buildings when merging with player
[*]The camera can now be zoomed out further
[*]Reduced amount of builders for the well from 2 to 1
[/list]

[h3]Map Generation[/h3]
[list]
[*]Improved visual quality of shores and water areas
[*]Improved road layout of NPC villages
[/list]

[h3]Misc[/h3]
[list]
[*]Shadow quality has been improved
[*]Rendering performance improvements in situations with a lot of piles on the screen
[*]Added more LOD levels to a lot of assets to improve performance
[*]Reduced VRAM usage 
[*]Disabled generated maps on specific old graphic drivers which are known to be unable to support procedural map generation. To unlock map generation an updated driver is required, otherwise those systems can only play the preselected maps and save games created on another system.
[*]Improved audio mixing
[*]Added bonus track “Off To New Shores“ to the soundtrack
[*]Improved various icons
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed: The workflow animations at the wood workshops had bugs
[*]Fixed: Workflow animations at the mint
[*]Fixed: Idle builders were blocking carriers bringing commodities
[*]Fixed: NPC camps were sometimes not destroyed after loosing all units
[*]Fixed: Addresses some issues during road placement
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.3.0
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Pioneers,[/h2]

We are thrilled to announce our new Pioneers of Pagonia update! After we celebrated the successful launch of Early Access in December 2023, we have been able to spend some time working on updates and improvements.

[b]What's new?[/b]
[list]
[*]Unit Selection Menu
[*]Attack Move Command
[*]Claiming at Tower and Garrison can now be paused
[*]Farmland can now be moved closer to the forest
[*]Improvements in Map Generation and UI
[*]And many more!
[/list]
Find the full list of changes in the patch notes below.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Developer Notes[/h2]

Thank you for your support and the vast amount of positive comments and feedback we have received since our Early Access launch in December 2023. We are truly grateful for our dedicated community!

Currently, we are collecting all of your feedback online. Our list counts more than 400 different suggestions and ideas. So it will take some time to discuss all of it and decide what is coming next. (Believe me, there are some really cool things coming!)

At the same time we are working on major new content updates. We will give you more details about it soon. Stay tuned and keep the feedback coming. This really helps us to improve and make Pioneers of Pagonia the best game it can be.

[h3]Unit Selection Menu[/h3]
First up is the new unit selection menu! For example, by clicking on a guard, you'll get more info about its duties, abilities and to which building it belongs. Quite neat, isn't it?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/c3ba1e03cea9ab501e2b4446fda418d2bc0a6172.gif[/img]

[h3]More Tooltips[/h3]
This feature also comes in handy for your hunters! You are now able to see the reason why an animal / a unit died. Which helps judging your hunter's efficiency and provides more info on what's happening in the game world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/4d4d23516561e7e3cd44c55fd36e371b3a4548a3.gif[/img]

[h3]Unit Follow Button[/h3]
With the unit selection menu comes the new follow button as requested by our community! By clicking on the little circle on the right, the camera follows the unit automatically. Now it's much more fun, observing what your Pagonians are up to!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/f9172b0d9ffd3213d2d5ece62658fc656b132789.gif[/img]

[h3]Attack Move Command[/h3]
This feature was also highly requested by our community. We included a separate attack-button, which enables the player to send their military units to any explored area without range limitation. Also, your patrol point won't be changed and your units will return to it once that battle is done.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/4ebb05039b49ea21a47479bac7ce9aad7bc714e7.gif[/img]

Now, fighting Pagonians foes will be more organized. Get your weapons and armor ready!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/7523e9839475a85fcd3cfeb92821dd578633579e.png[/img][i]New Attack Move Command Button (sword icon)[/i]

[h3]Pausing Territory Claiming[/h3]
One more major improvement is, that the claiming of territory can be paused. Hooray! No more guards serving as a little snack for hungry werewolves. :) Your guards can now chill in their safe place, while soldiers and fearnaughts do the dirty work. Border Stones will automatically be carried to other buildings, when claiming is stopped.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/c358e74ecf4998eb578649e1dcd34b92233203fb.png[/img][i]Claiming territory pause button[/i]

We hope, you enjoy these improvements in your next game session. See you in Pagonia!

[b]Pick up the tools, Pioneers. There is still so much do to![/b]
Your [i]Envision Entertainment [/i] Team

notes.title: Dev Blog #6: Feature Update – Combat, Military & Enemy Types
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Pioneers,[/h3]

Time is flying! Our closed beta playtest is almost ending, and Early Access launch day is just around the corner! A huge thanks to all our alpha and beta testers for providing such valuable feedback. This helps us tremendously. 

Before we return to our desks, we want to share with you some of the new features waiting for you in the Early Access Version! 

Since the beginning there is one question that has been asked the most by our community: How does combat work? Well, now we can finally share a few glimpses of our combat system! 

[h3]How Combat Works in Pioneers of Pagonia [/h3]
As many of you already know, Pioneers of Pagonia is no RTS. But you can control your units from the guard tower or the garrison. From there you can select the patrol point and click on the area where your military units should patrol. If there are enemies in the area, they will automatically engage in an attack. 

[h3]Enemy Types and How to Defeat Them [/h3]
There are a variety of enemies lurking in the fog! Some are easier and some are quite tough to defeat. Each enemy type has several tier levels (usually tier 1 to 3) which determines the enemy’s strength. The higher the tier-level, the stronger your military units must be to defeat them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/8c697f120a393a4740fecd95700417267d396c7d.gif[/img]

[h3]Bandits[/h3]
Bandits are crafty swordsmen and a real threat to your Pagonians. Depending on their tier-level they can be quite tough to defeat. You need to train higher-tier-level soldiers to stand a chance against elite bandits for example. When your explorer spots a bandit camp near your village, you will receive a notification. Explorer and other units fear enemies and will run away as soon as they encounter dangers!

[h3]Thieves[/h3]
Thieves will sneak into your village and steal valuable resources from your storage or treasury. What makes them hard to spot is their ability to disguise themselves as carrier units! Before they start to raid your village, they mask themselves, walk as a carrier unit into your village, steal the resource and bring it back to their camp. The only way to stop them is to attack their camp or train rangers in the adventurer's guild to expose the impostor and catch them before they steal your goods! 

[h3]Werewolves [/h3]
There are also mythical creatures roaming through the fog of Pagonia! Hungry werewolves are not to be messed with! They spawn in their moon glen and are one of the most dangerous enemies in Pagonia. Guards and soldiers will have a tough time defeating werewolves and are more likely to perish under the sharp claws and fangs of a werewolf. What makes them even more dangerous is their ability to bite your Pagonians and turn them into werewolves! Once this happens, your units will walk straight to the moon glen and transform into a werewolf themselves. You will need to train fearnaughts to defeat these feisty creatures! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/667bb86e824dbc2006be7076a91861af045c8705.gif[/img]

[h3]Spectres [/h3]
These unsettling creatures will send shivers down your spine! Spectres can be found next to a mysterious broken tomb and haunt your village if you get too close to their camp. It is best to send your fiercest units to defeat them. But we will not reveal them yet. If you want to find out more about this ghostly enemy type, you will have to wait for our Early Access release. :) 

[h3]Impact on Economy[/h3]
Of course, combat has an impact on your economy. If you want to train powerful military units, you need to gather resources and forge weapons and armor to provide for your soldiers. For Early Access there will be guards, soldiers, rangers and fearnaughts that can be trained in the military academy. All of them will have several tier levels (tier 1 to 3), depending on what kind of armor and weapons you are providing. 

There are more enemy types and military units on our agenda, but we will tackle these after Early Access. Now we are curious to know about your ideas for enemy types and military units! What do you think is missing in Pagonia? You are always welcome to share feedback and ideas on our discord server. 

[h3]Outlook: Map Gen, Neutral Factions and More! [/h3]
We seriously cannot wait to show you everything we have been working on in the last months! We are so excited for you to experience the unique islands of Pagonia and uncover the secrets that wait in the fog for you. Thank you for following us on our journey so far. Keep your eyes peeled for more updates until Early Access!

notes.content:
[h3]Dear Pioneers,[/h3]

Steam Next Fest has come to an end and we cannot believe that [b]Pioneers of Pagonia hit #7 in the ranking for most played demos![/b] Thank you so much for your support! We are still gathering all of the valuable feedback you have offered on Discord and Steam. All of your positive and kind words really motivate us to keep our pace and spirits high!

To all the late birds, hurry up! The public demo will be taken down on 23rd October 2023 at 2 pm (UTC+2). 

We have also read that a few people had issues starting the demo. We highly recommend to join our Discord and write us about your issue in detail. Our community and our devs are very supportive and will try to help you start the game. :)

Last week we were also part of this year's [b]Polaris Convention in Hamburg[/b] and had a little booth were the visitors could play the demo of Pagonia. Next to all the amazing Cosplayers it was great to meet a bunch of new people who have not heard of the game at all, but were instantly intrigued and excited for it. Shoutout to all the lovely Polaris people!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/71e4f243fc477e5ad22389051f2d9d8dc3cfabcc.png[/img]

Time is running fast! The next milestone is only less than two months away! Early Access is just around the corner and [b]will start on 13th December 2023[/b]. We are sooo excited that you are able to visit Pagonia again and this time with a lot more features. Here is our roadmap in detail, if you have not seen it already.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/3ab71f555ab35aafae7524c063a22e8e8d3b9bbc.png[/img]

Currently, we are working on combat, different enemy types and map generation. It will be possible to adjust the difficulty level of you map! You are more of the cozy gamer? No problem! You will be able to turn all combat off and concentrate on building that wonderful village of yours. You like more of a challenge? We got you! You can have a bigger number of enemies on your map, making it more difficult to expand your territory as you need to fight bandits and werewolves first.

We would like to end this blog with an announcement: We are so happy to make Pioneers of Pagonia available for a lot of international friends! For Early Access [b]we can confirm a total of 17 languages![/b] Let us know which languages are missing and what we should add for the future. (So far we have Hungarian, Greek and Klingon on the wishlist :D)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/2b0a96e63cd5e93d4c33c5f305a8b5e8ddf74ee2.png[/img]

Have a lovely autumnal season and see you in Pagonia for Christmas!

notes.title: Dev Blog #004: Gamescom Recap, Closed Alpha and more!
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Pioneers,[/h2]

our Closed Alpha has already started and we are very busy reading all your feedback! Thanks to everyone who is participating! The playtest continues until Monday, 25th September. If you have not received a key yet, please don't be sad. Our public demo is just around the corner, so everyone gets a chance to play very soon. :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/f89ee15bfae7349a7d9818375cfaceb1f8f8021d.png[/img]

[h2]Gamescom 2023[/h2]

We were so happy to showcase Pioneers of Pagonia in collaboration with Indie Arena Booth at this year's gamescom! We were truly overwhelmed by the sheer amount of people waiting in line to play the game for the first time! Receiving all your positive feedback and seeing the happy faces of our community really made this whole experience very special. We could not have asked for a better first gamescom! Thanks to everyone who stopped by our booth, played and wishlisted the game and keeps following us on our journey. :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/f9d391cabe0c0ccddcbaa08c6c02275ca505071f.png[/img]

[h2]Gamescom Award Nomination : Most Wholesome[/h2]

We were over the moon to be nominated with so many other amazing devs for a gamescom award in the category "Most Wholesome". Even though we did not win, we appreciate being nominated and recognized for our cozy vibes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/94f69ace91fc8514951bf1ca2588db8fdac475f7.png[/img]

[h2]Bandits & Thieves[/h2]

Some of our playtesters asked us, if there are more challenges in our game than building a village and exploring the island. And, of course, there are! Not everything is calm and peaceful in Pagonia.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/4fb455f5a840995b4710c25b57bb19f7a89d3818.png[/img]

Thieves sneakily try to steal goods lying around within your territory and return them to their base. This is where your guards come in! If they catch a thief red-handed, your guards will chase them away. In this case stolen goods are dropped immediately. 

Guards will only protect your own land, but soldiers are able to patrol outside your territory, which is necessary to defeat these masked fellows: Bandits! They are roaming the lands of Pagonia and are a lot less subtle than thieves. They will attack your carriers or traders, chase them away and plunder carried goods. 

The only way to protect your units from being robbed is by sending your soldiers to defeat the bandits in combat. If your soldiers manage to take down a bandit camp, they will be able to retrieve some of the stolen goods. On the other hand, bandits will increase in numbers, if plundering goes successfully. 

Both bandits and thieves scan their environment searching for interesting goods and are more likely to steal silver coins instead of roast venison.

notes.title: Dev Blog #003
notes.content:
[h3]Dear fellow Pioneers,[/h3]

First, we would like to thank you for your positive response to our reveal trailer we launched two weeks ago! We were thrilled to read all your kind comments and see the excitement you have for our game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/9aaacbdee80fd5f4e56ffdb12e79b862514a69ce.png[/img]

A couple of days before release we celebrated together with our team from Envision Entertainment. We watched the trailer three times in a row, hence the concentrated faces 😄 Anyway, we are very thankful for your support and fully motivated to keep up the pace and deliver the best game possible for Early Access!
 
If you like to contribute your thoughts or ideas, do not hesitate to join our discord where we discuss interesting questions about the game and its planned features. Our devs are also active there. 😊

[url=https://discord.gg/ZaNFjtnT7u]Join our discord here[/url]

[h3]gamescom Announcement[/h3]

[previewyoutube=Q4bH1NMQfik;full][/previewyoutube]

The trailer wasn’t the only big news, as there are more exciting things to announce this week: We are so happy to share that we will be a part of the incredible line-up of [b]Indie Arena Booth[/b] at gamescom this year! There will probably be a playable version at our booth, so feel free to visit us, play the game and have a chat. We can’t wait to meet you there! 

[h3]Trading Post & Trade Carrier[/h3]
We will dismiss this Dev Blog with some new information about the trade system in Pagonia! 

As a visionary it is your objective to forge alliances with the inhabitants of the islands and to help each other. First, your explorers will find them and locate their trade center to learn about their needs and offers. If you help them by solving their problems or delivering something they urgently need, you will earn their trust. In exchange they will offer valuable trade goods for barter or even free rewards for pick-up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/1825752f92c95ce3f27a1201c94e547172c73e3b.png[/img]

Any traded goods are, of course, transported across the game world. Your residents will transport the desired commodities to your trading posts. Fun fact: The traders belong to the few civilian unit types that can leave your territory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/ee5e44afd473264bdb0cfd9edb8aaf92f2e9e5be.png[/img]

They will travel to the trading post of your trading partner and pick up the other party’s trade goods and return them to your territory. That does not mean that the journey is totally safe as it can be violated by intruders. But we will go into more detail about this in our next update!

notes.title: Dev-Blog #002: Get to know Pagonia
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Steam-Community![/h2]

Thanks for all your kind comments and likes on our first Dev-Blog and the [b]»Get to know Pagonia«[/b]-Series. Today we would like to share more information about the game! Especially the food resources, which are planned for Early Access, and all the steps it takes to feed everyone living in Pagonia. 😊

[h3]So, let's start![/h3]

There are several resources that can be hunted, gathered or harvested. For example, the fisher will catch herrings in the ocean and trout in lakes, while the hunter pursues rabbits, wild boars and deer. But not all food supplies will come from animals. The forager can find hidden porcini and delicious raspberries. Whereas farmers are growing crops and vegetables.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/4632b5bfed72104ebe5ba4d1576f8b51b17e1db1.png[/img]

[h3]Farming[/h3]

Pagonian farmers are working on fields nearby the vegetable farm. For Early Access, you can grow pumpkins and cabbages. After sowing the seed and watering the plants with water from the well (which the units will do automatically) the veggies will be harvested and delivered to market stalls.
 
The crop farm is designed for growing wheat, corn and flax. Once harvested, the goods are waiting to be picked up for further processing. Corn goes to the market stalls and wheat goes to the windmill for producing flour. Flax will be carried to the weaver where it is used to make cloth and rope. However, flax does not need to be grown, it can be foraged, too.

Good farmers know their land! In Pagonia it does make a difference where certain plants are grown. For example, the cultivation of wheat requires more fertile lands, which are much harder to find. Pumpkins, on the other hand, grow pretty much everywhere! In order to get the best farming results, you can assign the farm field according to the different terrain types.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/55492e61a8175222f9807dbcd14cc98bb0b009b1.png[/img]

[h3]Tavern[/h3]

Obviously, wheat is the main ingredient for baking bread, but you will have to mill it first, add water from a well and use firewood to heat the oven of the bakery. 

The meal ingredients will be delivered to market stalls, where cooks of the tavern will fetch them and prepare excellent meals. But to have delicious meals on the table, the cooks of Pagonia must prepare the food accordingly, which happens in the tavern.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/c0681bec38e0e57e22eeac6671d8b63263dc2173.png[/img]

[h3]Meals & Rations[/h3]

The cooks will collect food ingredients from nearby market stalls based on suitability and availability. One type of meal preferably uses ingredients with high nutritional value, like bread or boar meat, which is made for craftsmen doing heavy work like mining.

But what about the rest of Pagonia's inhabitants? The other type of meal is for the occupants of the residences in which the new little Pagonians are born. The residents will have their lunch and dinner at the tavern, and they prefer to eat deer meat and porcini mushrooms a lot more than eating pumpkins!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/0bb87b3a9d7628fea265b825b187eb593eba29b8.png[/img]

In order to preserve food for a longer period of time, fish and meat will be smoked at the provisioner. In combination with bread from the bakery the cooks working at provisioner will produce rations for civilian units like explorers to travel beyond your borders and use their skills elsewhere. 

No Pagonian will do their work with an empty stomach, this is a fact! 😊

notes.title: Dev-Blog #001: Get to know Pagonia
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Steam-Community![/h2]
Thank you all for your huge support and the many messages we received since our announcement of Pioneers of Pagonia in February 2023. The game is in pre-alpha-status, but we cannot wait to share more info with you! In the past weeks we have been uploading a few glimpses behind the scenes of developing the game on social media. So, it’s about time, we share some more information with you on steam as well!

Let’s begin with our [b]»Get-to-know-Pagonia«[/b]-Series, where we show several aspects of the game, the lore and general features in Pioneers of Pagonia.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/08b19b53d6323e3e305730b1876ee5f049dfc953.png[/img]

[h3]The World of Pagonia[/h3]
Originally, Pagonia is a world of countless islands populated with scattered villages, where skillful inhabitants live in peace. A cataclysm of unknown origin caused the world to get out of balance: Forests are infested with thorn tendrils, mountain passes are impassable by landslides, villages are invaded by thieves and cursed creatures are sighted in many places. This separates the villages from each other and causes their inhabitants to face serious challenges.

This is where [b]you[/b] come in! Your goal is to lead the Pagonians as a visionary and forge alliances with the inhabitants, helping each other and gaining their trust. You will send out your pioneers to discover untouched soil, find hidden resources and explore secret places.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/5b0669edeb05ded0b172c49a18a671a8b08210c3.png[/img]

[h3]Procedural Maps[/h3]
The infinite variations of the procedurally generated maps offer new challenges every time. Procedural generation of content is a powerful tool which is already very important for many games. Some people mistake procedural generation with complete randomness. Instead, it means there is a designed ruleset which creates interesting content, where the quality can be improved by better rules and algorithms continuously.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/3ae42a2cb2116e4caf480fc0ba7a8d55e2098e60.png[/img]

For Pioneers of Pagonia, a simulation with many different interconnected game systems, procedural content fits excellently. We procedurally generate the map layout and terrain distribution, resource amount and allocation, locations for hostile and friendly inhabitants and their objectives. The combination of those challenges will be unique on each map. Another advantage of procedural content is that it leads to unusual situations, which a level designer may have never thought of.

[h3]Meet the Pagonians[/h3]
They are the protagonists of the game! Without them, Pagonia would not be such a busy place, as it is their purpose to take jobs as workers, builders, carriers and many more. They play an essential role in the flourishing economy of Pagonia, as we are aiming to achieve several thousand units bustling around the world going on about their business and keep things going!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/a52720bffba5971f710786233752b7e5fcf9b409.png[/img]

One of the frequently asked questions is, if there is a combat system or how the combat system works. In Pioneers of Pagonia we will not offer RTS-like unit controls. Instead, military and mystical units are tied to buildings as their base and will be controlled from there, e.g. by telling them where to claim new territory, which area to guard or which location to scout for enemies.

Units, which patrol or scout an area and find a preferable target they are looking for, will automatically engage. For example, your guards will chase thieves away. Soldiers will attack bandits, but hostile spirits will attack your soldiers, while your sorcerers hunt the spirits. Depending on unit types and their individual strength and weaknesses, there are good and bad match ups.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/123d9fcfbbb00b3b1528da993c69e9c261619e53.jpg[/img]

[h3]Buildings & Production[/h3]
In Pagonia every transportation, resource gathering, and production process is visualized. Besides that, the game world delivers a lot more visual information. A few examples for visualization are: harvestable plants, different terrain types, the status and setup of buildings, the amount of input and output goods at a building and much more. The goal is, that everyone can fully understand what is happening, just by watching the game world.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/3902dc8bd5df2c179aa369eacecffd49204bbba1.png[/img]

Keep in mind that you do not have to control the units, they automatically execute your orders! The main interface offers a summary of all your available units, resources, and buildings with additional information, such as how many carriers are idle, how many goods stored surplus or how many buildings of a specific type are still under construction. Notifications keep you updated about notable events and the resizable mini map ensures a good overview.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/b6969a1dd875bdd5145bd40fd536b39e08d476bd.png[/img]

For Early Access, we will have more than 40 different buildings available and plan to continuously extend the tech-tree after that step by step. We also decided to focus on a single faction for Early Access. Instead of offering multiple player factions with fewer buildings and limited production chains, we decided to go for one bigger faction with much more variety. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43619279/ce9dccbf0377a1b20490b64e2a445c5f69f00897.png[/img]

Additionally, there will be more than 70 different commodities in the player's production chains. As we plan to release additional building types later, the variety of goods will continue to increase. With thousands of wares transported at once, logistics will play an important role in Pioneers of Pagonia. Bad planning may cause a collapse by overburdened transport units or incredible traffic jams at bottlenecks. Details about road types and transport units are not yet defined and will be revealed later.

notes.title: Pioneers of Pagonia Announced
notes.content:
Today, award-winning German indie studio Envision Entertainment is announcing Pioneers of Pagonia, a vibrant city builder coming to PC. Developed under the creative direction of Volker Wertich, the original creator of the famous The Settlers series — which sold more than 10 million copies worldwide — Pioneers of Pagonia will launch into Early Access for PC by the End of 2023, and can now be wishlisted on Steam.

Pioneers of Pagonia is the ultimate simulation title, a return to classic city building gameplay where players will discover and explore the fabled islands of Pagonia and forge alliances with its many inhabitants. With over 40 different building types and over 70 different goods and dispersed production chains available in Early Access, players can get creative in building their own unique economy. Watch it come to life through stunning animations for all goods transports, production processes, and discoveries of the population. Thanks to the procedurally generated maps, countless variations are possible for a unique game experience every time.

Exploration of the islands also plays a significant role in Pioneers of Pagonia; you can discover lost treasures, underground resources, fertile lands, and hidden places. Although you’ll have to be careful, as not all inhabitants of these beautiful islands are peaceful. A co-op mode is also being planned, so players can explore and develop the islands of Pagonia together.

“With Pioneers of Pagonia, we’re returning to the origins of city building simulation, with thousands of inhabitants scurrying around and a focus on the in-depth simulation of the game world and economy that the community loves so much,” said Volker Wertich, Creative Director at Envision Entertainment.

The development of Pioneers of Pagonia was financially supported by the German games fund grant by the Federal Ministry of Economics and Climate Protection.

To stay up to date on Pioneers of Pagonia, be sure to follow on [url=https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100089486270344]Facebook[/url], join [url=https://discord.gg/3ADebJKENC]Discord [/url]or visit the official [url=https://www.pioneersofpagonia.com]website[/url].
